personality_one_liner: A precision instrument for the road—high-contrast, dense yet breathable, and elegantly utilitarian.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content. Clear grouping of related elements. Use sticky CTAs over scrolling content.

do's: Bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Floating search bar over the Map
Bottom-sheet handles and headers for client details on map

screens.name: Global Navigation
screens.purpose: Consolidate the sprawling 7-tab bar into a focused, ergonomic 4-tab structure.
screens.layout: Reduce bottom tabs to 4: Dashboard, Mappa, Clienti, Altro (Menu). Move Ordini, Prodotti, Calendario, Profilo into the 'Altro' drawer or list menu. Use outlined Ionicons for inactive tabs, filled for active. Apply glassmorphism to the tab bar.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide a fast, scannable overview of the day's priorities and quick actions.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for stats and appointments.
states.empty: Illustration of a clean desk with 'Nessun dato per oggi'.
states.error: Text 'Errore di caricamento' with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Remove generic white cards on grey backgrounds. Use edge-to-edge sectioned lists with generous vertical breathing room. 'Appuntamenti Imminenti' (Upcoming appointments) should be a horizontal scroll section at the top. 'Azioni Rapide' (Quick actions) in a 2-column grid (`justifyContent: 'space-between'`, `gap: md`).

screens.name: Mappa Punti Vendita
screens.purpose: Visualize clients spatially with clear status indicators, optimized for outdoor visibility.

states.error: Map load error with Retry button.

screens.layout: Keep Leaflet in WebView, but redesign the chrome. Unify the search bar as a floating element at the top with `expo-blur`. Replace messy Leaflet HTML popups with a native `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` that slides up when a marker is tapped, displaying client details and primary circular actions (Naviga, Ordine, Ispezione). Map marker colors: Green (success), Amber (warning), Red (error), Zinc/Grey (info) - avoid purple.

screens.name: Raccolta Ordine (Order Wizard)
screens.purpose: Streamline the complex 5-step order process into a frictionless, linear flow.
screens.layout: Single-column layout only. Display a clear step tracker at the top (e.g., 'Step 2 of 5: Prodotti'). Anchor a sticky, full-width primary CTA button at the very bottom (above the safe area) labeled with contextual action verbs (e.g., 'Continua al Pagamento'). Use `KeyboardAvoidingView` appropriately. Group related fields to reduce cognitive load.

splash_background.alt: Abstract textured wall with warm terracotta color block

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'iOS-Native Clean' personality. Avoid all muddy palettes, blue/purple/indigo SaaS defaults, and excessive shadows.
Replace the current 7-tab bar with a 4-tab bar (Dashboard, Mappa, Clienti, Altro).
Replace the generic '#1E40AF' (blue) and '#7C3AED' (purple) with the new 'brand' palette based on Signal Rust/Terracotta (#C2410C). Update map marker colors to align with the new status tokens.

Map View: Do not edit Leaflet tiles. Instead, implement a native floating search bar and intercept marker taps to trigger a native `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` for client details, removing web-based popups.
Order Wizard: Implement a sticky, full-width CTA at the bottom of the screen. Content must scroll behind it. Add a progress tracker at the top.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' font family across the app. Cap font weight at 500 max. Use size for hierarchy.
Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44pt.
Apply `expo-blur` to the tab bar, floating search bar on the map, and bottom sheet headers.
